header: What each desk at Northstar takes care of

items.title: Commissioning
items.content: Plans each issue nine months ahead, invites authors and keeps a list of subjects the Quarterly has not yet covered well.

items.title: Research operations
items.content: Keeps the roster of 210 referees up to date, checks turnaround times every Monday and steps in when a manuscript passes 30 days.

items.title: Rights and archive
items.content: Clears permissions, registers DOIs and opens every paper to all readers 12 months after its issue date.
